Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: redesigned secondary screen for Hush Android, visually consistent with user's selected dark editorial home.
Output: ONE precise flat full-screen portrait 9:20 app screenshot, no phone frame or outside labels. Deep pine #111B17 page, tonal surface #1C2922, paper #EDF3EC text, sage #C4D8CB accents, muted #B3C3B6. Manrope-like native sans-serif, fine borders, flat restrained surfaces, consistent 22dp horizontal gutters, real 48dp tap targets. Status bar 9:41 and safe Android gesture line. No invented stats, streaks, recommendation feeds, gradients, large photo backgrounds or extra functionality.
Primary request: BREATHE tab SETUP screen fixing the current oversized orb and Start button below viewport.
Top title "Breathe" 28sp left. Under title a compact two-choice segmented control "Breathe" selected and "Meditate" secondary, reusing existing breathing and meditation tools. No search field on this tab.
Center a refined breathing ring illustration ONLY 150dp diameter, two fine sage concentric incomplete arcs, low contrast tonal center, no huge filled disks or glow. Under ring centered "Calm · 4 in, 6 out" 19sp and smaller "3 min". Setup state, no active inhale countdown.
Below visual, a slim 56dp technique selector row with small ring icon, text "Calm · 4 in, 6 out", trailing chevron, dark tonal rounded background. Small heading "Duration", three equal 48dp pills "1 min", "3 min", "5 min", middle selected sage with deep pine text. Then one quiet row "Sound cues" and native switch on.
A prominent 52dp pale sage filled button "Start breathing" is ENTIRELY VISIBLE around y=650dp, comfortably ABOVE the bottom navigation with 24dp gap. No End or Pause button before session starts.
Bottom inset rounded nav tray 72dp tall, equal 22dp side margins aligning with technique and Start button. Exactly three equal items Search, Games, Breathe; magnifier, gamepad, lowercase h icons, all labels visible; Breathe selected small sage-toned capsule behind icon. Leave safe gesture gap below tray.
CRITICAL: ring, technique, duration, sound and Start all fit one realistic 412x915dp screen. No video PiP or audio strip in this idle setup mockup. Clear hierarchy and moderately compact spacing. This has calm identity AND immediately usable controls.
